name: DeepSeek
summary: Direct DeepSeek API with optional model routes and same-key native user balance monitoring.

credentials.label: DeepSeek API key
credentials.help: Enter privately in lain. Existing user balance is read through this same key.

setupSteps.title: Use your existing account
setupSteps.description: Sign in to your own DeepSeek account. No purchase or account creation is performed by lain.

setupSteps.title: Connect an existing API key
setupSteps.description: Enter the key in the private API-key field. No account ID is requested; the user balance endpoint selects its user through the key.

setupSteps.title: Keep models optional
setupSteps.description: Create the account first, then optionally attach documented models. Connecting does not send an inference request or apply a profile.

billingPlans.name: API account balance
billingPlans.notes: Actual CNY and USD available balances are read separately. No fixed grant, spending limit, reset, conversion or recurring allowance is assumed.

sources.title: DeepSeek Get User Balance
sources.notes: Native CNY/USD total_balance strings; granted and topped-up balances are components, not additional pools.

restrictions: Use your own existing API key. No qualified public OAuth flow is implemented.
Connecting does not purchase credit, run inference, attach model routes or apply a profile.
CNY and USD balances remain separate. Total balance already includes granted and topped-up components.
The balance response contains no user identifier. Provider-only declared binding is supported; asserted user/resource identity cannot be verified.
Legacy deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner names are not assumed to be current. Current canonical documented IDs are offered.
